text:
Lena Ortiz: Hi all  I'm new this week. Set up my desk but the office Wi-Fi (redwood-guest?) keeps dropping while my monitor says "No Signal" intermittently when waking the laptop. Is this a network issue or my dock/HDMI? Anyone know who to ping?

Chris Park: Welcome Lena! Ping IT Support. Quick troubleshooting: are you using company Wi-Fi (redwood-office) or guest? also does the monitor regain signal if you reseat the HDMI?

Lena Ortiz: I'm on redwood-office SSID and using the DockMate D3 (USB-C to dual HDMI). Reseated HDMI cables twice, still blinks No Signal after sleep. Wi-Fi disconnect happens around the same time as monitor loss.

Maya Chen: Could be the dock dropping both display and USB NIC. @IT Support can you check if DockMate D3 firmware has known sleep issues? Lena which desk are you at?

IT Support: Creating ticket IT-4992: "DockMate D3 - monitor HDMI handshake & Wi-Fi drop after sleep". Assigned to Chris Park. ETA on swap: same day drop if ops available, else courier within 48h. Please confirm desk location.

Lena Ortiz: Desk C1-04 (3rd window row). Thanks!

Chris Park: I'll stop by at 11:30 with a loaner DockMate D2 we keep in the ops cabinet. That will isolate if dock is the cause. If the loaner fixes both screen and Wi-Fi, we'll RMA D3.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4992 created and assigned to Chris Park on 1771000025.

Chris Park: Swapped docks at 11:35. Loaner D2 (asset DM-1107) connected. Monitor resumes reliably after sleep and the redwood-office Wi-Fi stays connected.

Lena Ortiz: Confirmed — no more No Signal and Wi-Fi stable for the last hour. Huge help, thanks Chris!

Maya Chen: Welcome to the team, Lena! If you need any onboarding stuff (access, docs) ping me.

Chris Park: Marking IT-4992 resolved: replaced DockMate D3 (flagged for RMA) with loaner DM-1107. If the loaner behaves strangely later, file a follow-up. :white_check_mark:

it-bot: Ticket IT-4992 status changed to RESOLVED by Chris Park on 1771000245.
